subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` make `/v1/chat/completions` ignore or tolerate a generic OpenAI body `model`, despite the current documented agent-first model contract?
rationale: The code path is small, but the choice changes public API semantics for model selection and may need parity decisions across Responses and embeddings.

options.title: Adopt header precedence
options.body: Accept generic body models as client compatibility metadata when a valid agent header selects the agent, and add docs/tests for the chosen endpoint set.

options.title: Preserve agent-first model contract
options.body: Keep requiring `model` to be `openclaw`, `openclaw/default`, or `openclaw/<agentId>`, and document SDK integrations to send that value with optional `x-openclaw-model`.

options.title: Decide shared OpenAI-compatible semantics first
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose a consistent precedence rule for Chat Completions, Responses, and embeddings.

recommendation.title: Decide shared OpenAI-compatible semantics first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose a consistent precedence rule for Chat Completions, Responses, and embeddings.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc introduced the agent-first OpenAI-compatible model contract and related endpoint behavior this issue would modify.
